active_gaps.description: Serverless route handlers must ensure heavy LLM calls or multi-agent summarization terminate strictly under 10s to avoid 504 Gateway Timeouts.
active_gaps.remediation: Enforce strict HTTP client timeouts (<8s) with graceful fallback to cached knowledge base context.

active_gaps.description: Stdout must be exclusively reserved for JSON-RPC 2.0 payloads during stdio transport to prevent corrupting Claude Desktop / Cursor client parsing.
active_gaps.remediation: Route all internal logs, metrics, and diagnostics strictly to stderr or file logging.

active_gaps.description: Scout pipeline must remain resilient under zero-token environments when GITHUB_TOKEN is expired or exhausted.
active_gaps.remediation: Maintain unauthenticated raw RSS / public event feed fallback with exponential backoff.
